chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: Sister Eutris buys his first trombone
summary: His sister Eutris bought the trombone for $11 without a case.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: You mentioned that your brother, while he was teaching at Morris Brown -
I know but that brother who was teaching at Morris Brown, he's the one who bought you your first trombone when you were 14?
No, my sister bought it. I told you that yesterday.
I thought it was your brother.
It was my brother, but not the one that bought the trombone. My sister bought it.

Yes, she bought the trombone and I played a couple of notes on it and the next day I was trying to play and I continued to play on that horn. So she paid for it, $11, and that's all they got without a case...
You played that trombone for a long time... That particular trombone was the one that you played your first professional job on, when you first played for any amount of money?
